name: rejected_records
description: Verra records that could not be read, kept with the reason and their exact text so nothing is lost silently.
grain: One row per unreadable record in any landing file of the snapshot.

columns.name: target_table
columns.description: The bronze table the record was meant for.

columns.name: line_count
columns.description: How many physical lines the record spans; one broken quote can swallow many.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the record could not be read.

columns.name: raw_text
columns.description: The record exactly as it appears in the file.
